newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia Balongan refinery maintenance starts.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Balongan refinery maintenance starts.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina started the scheduled total maintenance shutdown of its 125,000-barrel-per-day Balongan refinery on Tuesday, a refinery source said on Wednesday.
The shutdown, which includes the crude distillation unit and all the secondary units will last for at least 42 days and a maximum period of 60 days, he told Reuters by telephone.
"We will have a complete maintenance so that the refinery would be maintenance-free for the next three years," he said.
This is the first major shutdown at the refinery since it started operations in May 1994.
The refinery has been running at slightly over its design capacity since April 26, he said.
The Balongan refinery in West Java, processes 80 percent of Duri crude and 20 percent of Minas.
